P.name: Void Stone
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Kassadin''' is permanently {{tip|ghosted}} and takes 10% reduced {{tip|magic damage|{{as|magic damage}}}}.

Q.name: Null Sphere
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kassadin''' fires an orb of void energy at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|disrupt|disrupts}} their ongoing {{tip|channel|channels}}.
Q.description2: He also gains a {{tip|shield}} that absorbs {{as|magic damage}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.

W.name: Nether Blade
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Kassadin's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{as|25|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kassadin''' empowers his next basic attack {{tip|on-hit}} within 5 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}}, deal increased {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}, and restore {{sti|{{as|mana}}}}, with the restoration amount quintupled against {{tip|champion|champions}}.
W.leveling2:
{{st|Increased Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|50 to 150}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}}}
{{st|Mana Restored|{{as|{{ap|4 to 6}}% of '''missing''' mana}}|Mana Restored Against Champions|{{as|{{ap|4*5 to 6*5}}% of '''missing''' mana}}}}
W.description3: ''Nether Blade {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Kassadin's''' basic attack timer.''

E.name: Force Pulse
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Each time '''Kassadin''' or a nearby {{tip|champion}} casts an [[champion ability|ability]], ''Force Pulse's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by {{fd|0.75}} seconds.
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kassadin''' emits a pulse of void energy in a cone in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for 1 second.

R.name: Riftwalk
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kassadin''' {{tip|blinks}} toward the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies upon arrival. He then gains a stack of ''Riftwalk'' for 15 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 4 times.
R.description2: {{sbc|Riftwalk:}} For each stack, ''Riftwalk'' deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} at an increased {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}}.
R.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Damage Per Stack|{{ap|35 to 55}} {{as|(+ 7% AP)}} {{as|(+ 1% '''maximum''' mana)}}|Maximum Bonus Damage|{{ap|35*4 to 55*4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|7*4}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ 4% '''maximum''' mana)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|80+35*4 to 110+55*4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50+7*4}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ 6% '''maximum''' mana)}}}}
